strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Buɗe takardun manhajar ka amince da sigogin da ake buƙata. Suna bayyana sharuɗɗan amfani, sirri da iyakokin aminci ga ƙararrawa, sanarwa da ƙararrawar wuri.
strings.onboarding_documents_required_pending: Ba a amince da takardun da ake buƙata ba tukuna.
strings.onboarding_documents_required_accepted: An amince da takardun da ake buƙata.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Ba a buƙatar izini don duba manhajar, amma ƙararrawa, tunatarwa da ƙararrawar wuri sun dogara da sanarwa, ƙararrawa masu daidaitaccen lokaci, wuri da saitunan baturi.
strings.onboarding_cannot_continue_documents: Amince da takardu don ci gaba
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Za ka iya kammalawa yanzu ka dawo ga izini daga baya ta Saituna.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Buɗe jagorar mai amfani ba tare da intanet ba a wata tagar burauza.
strings.help_training_offer_title: Koyi yadda ake amfani da ShiftAlarm
strings.help_training_offer_body: Buɗe jagorar mai amfani don koyon aikin kowane babban fasali, inda yake, abin da za a taɓa da abin da za a duba idan wani abu bai yi aiki yadda ake tsammani ba.
strings.help_training_offer_hint: Jagorar tana buɗewa a matsayin shafin gida daban, don haka za ka iya sauyawa tsakanin jagorar da manhajar yayin bin matakan.
strings.help_training_offer_open_failed: Ba a iya buɗe jagorar ba. Sake gwadawa daga Saituna.
